items.headline: Futures Mixed as Wall Street Awaits PPI Data After Cooling CPI
items.summary: U.S. stock futures are trading mixed on Thursday as investors digest Wednesday's softer-than-expected Consumer Price Index (CPI) report and anticipate the release of July's Producer Price Index (PPI) later today. The overall market sentiment remains cautious, influenced by inflation data and ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Tech and AI-related stocks continue to show strength, while some sectors saw declines in the previous session. Not financial advice.

items.headline: Gaxos.ai Surges on Q2 Revenue Beat
items.summary: Gaxos.ai shares rose more than 63% in premarket trading after the company reported stronger-than-expected second-quarter revenue.

items.headline: Iveda Solutions Continues Ascent
items.summary: Iveda Solutions stock climbed 36% in premarket, extending a 26% gain from the previous session.

items.headline: Omeros Jumps on Strong Q2 Results
items.summary: Omeros shares surged 15% following a strong Q2 performance, driven by the commercial launch of YARTEMLEA, with revenue and adjusted EPS surpassing expectations.

items.headline: Cerebras Systems Tumbles on Revenue Miss
items.summary: Cerebras Systems Inc. tumbled 17.4% in premarket after the AI hardware and supercomputing company missed Wall Street's second-quarter revenue estimates.

items.headline: StubHub Declines After Q2 Loss
items.summary: StubHub Holdings, Inc. fell over 13% in premarket as the company failed to turn a profit in the second quarter, despite increased revenue.

items.headline: Cisco Systems Falls Despite Strong Earnings
items.summary: Cisco Systems Inc. shares declined 6.2% in premarket trading, even after reporting better-than-expected Q4 fiscal 2026 results, potentially due to profit-taking following a significant year-to-date rally.

items.headline: Investors Await July PPI Report for Further Inflation Clues
items.summary: The U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) for July is scheduled for release today at 8:30 a.m. ET (12:30 PM UTC). Economists anticipate the index to show a 0.2% increase from the previous month, offering additional insights into wholesale inflation trends.

items.headline: Cooling CPI Eases Federal Reserve Rate Hike Concerns
items.summary: Wednesday's Consumer Price Index (CPI) data revealed a moderation in inflation, with the annual rate slowing to 3.4% in July from 3.5% in June, aligning with market expectations. This subdued inflation print has helped to calm jitters around potential Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.

items.headline: AI and Tech Sector Continue to Drive Market Gains
items.summary: The artificial intelligence (AI) theme remains a significant market driver, contributing to the strong performance of tech stocks and major indices like the Nasdaq and S&P 500. Demand for AI hardware, software, and data centers continues to fuel investment and growth in the sector.

items.headline: Geopolitical Tensions Weigh on Oil Prices
items.summary: Lingering geopolitical frictions, particularly concerning the Strait of Hormuz, are contributing to volatility and a decline in oil prices. Brent crude is trading around $88 per barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude is near $82-$83 per barrel.

items.headline: Key Companies Report Earnings Today
items.summary: Several major companies are scheduled to release earnings reports today, August 13, 2026, including Applied Materials Inc. ($AMAT), Brookfield Corporation ($BN), and JD.com Inc. ($JD). Bullish ($BLSH) and Trend Micro ($TYO:4704) have already reported their Q2 2026 results.
